examples.answer:
You should submit expense claims in **SpendHub**. Claims must be submitted in SpendHub within 30 calendar days of the expense date. [IronStore_Expense_Reimbursement_Policy.pdf, p. 5]

Note: the Employee Handbook also says business expenses must be submitted in **SpendFlow** within 30 days of the transaction, which conflicts with the current Finance policy. The current expense reimbursement policy is the more specific and more recent source, so use **SpendHub** and confirm with Finance if needed. [IronStore_Employee_Handbook.pdf, p. 4] [IronStore_Expense_Reimbursement_Policy.pdf, p. 5]

Confidence: High
